about: Measured outcome shares that replace the equal-outcome convention (k of n outcomes: k/n) for generated SR/SSR chain events. Per card: the link, the choice (1-based) and each outcome's share keyed by the skill that marks it. Applied by the event builders (Global and both GM-era variants) to `chain` and as `alt_w` (outcome weights per choice) for the solver. Measured on uma-it runs where every outcome could show (docs/MODEL.md); set to the adopted value.
